summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares gedatolisib plus palbociclib and endocrine therapy with ribociclib and endocrine therapy as first-line treatment for HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. Gedatolisib is given intravenously once weekly for 3 weeks (days 1, 8, and 15), followed by 1 week off; palbociclib and ribociclib are taken by mouth on days 1-21 of each 28-day cycle, and fulvestrant is given by intramuscular injection. The record does not state a primary outcome; it describes the study as evaluating efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara gedatolisib más palbociclib y terapia endocrina con ribociclib y terapia endocrina como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de mama avanzado HR positivo y HER2 negativo. El gedatolisib se administra por vía intravenosa una vez por semana durante 3 semanas (días 1, 8 y 15), seguido de 1 semana sin tratamiento; el palbociclib y el ribociclib se toman por vía oral los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el fulvestrant se administra por inyección intramuscular. El registro no indica un resultado principal; describe el estudio como una evaluación de la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Adults with HR-positive, HER2-negative metastatic or locally advanced breast cancer.
Disease progression during or within 12 months after (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy, or after 12 months.
Archival or fresh tumor tissue, or liquid biopsy, available for PIK3CA mutation testing.
Radiologically measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status 0-2 and life expectancy over 6 months.
not_for: Prior PI3K, Akt, or mTOR inhibitor, or other SERD except fulvestrant, in the (neo)adjuvant setting.
Prior systemic anticancer therapy for advanced breast cancer.
Type 1 diabetes, or type 2 diabetes uncontrolled and requiring daily insulin.
Known untreated or active brain or leptomeningeal metastases.
Other concurrent malignancy (except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer), or prior drug-induced interstitial lung disease or hepatitis.
